links.outcome: LLM accuracy on pediatric versus adult MedQA questions, by model
links.effect: Five of eight models scored significantly lower on pediatric questions, with drops of up to more than 10 percentage points; ChatGPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro and Claude 3.5 Sonnet showed comparable performance (ChatGPT-4o 83.57% adult, 83.18% pediatric; p = 0.80).
links.quote: Five models (Amazon Nova Pro 1.0, GPT 3.5-turbo-0125, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Grok 2, and Claude 3 Sonnet) demonstrated significantly lower performance on pediatric questions, with accuracy drops of up to more than 10 percentage points.

links.outcome: Performance of general-purpose LLMs on pediatric content, a specialized population not specifically validated
links.effect: Five of eight LLMs performed significantly worse on pediatric than adult questions (up to more than 10 percentage points lower); three newer models performed comparably across domains.
links.quote: Five models (Amazon Nova Pro 1.0, GPT 3.5-turbo-0125, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Grok 2, and Claude 3 Sonnet) demonstrated significantly lower performance on pediatric questions, with accuracy drops of up to more than 10 percentage points.

screen.reason: Evaluates several commercial LLMs on adult vs. pediatric subsets of the MedQA benchmark to assess domain-specific accuracy.
